snippet.title: Silvanis | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
The forest took your daughter. Now, it wants your sanity. Silvanis - coming soon to Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3754050/Silvanis/

Venture into the cursed depths of a mysterious psychological nightmare on a desperate search for your missing child. Surrounded by chilling whispers, unseen presences, and cryptic puzzles, you must uncover the dark secrets hiding in the shadows of abandoned homes. Track the clues, face your deepest fears, and survive the suffocating terror of the woods before they claim you both.
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
